can_do_vi: Gọi món lịch sự với "I'd like..."
Hỏi về món ăn và xin hoá đơn
grammar_note_vi: Gọi món lịch sự: "I'd like a bowl of pho, please." ("I'd like" là "I would like", lịch sự hơn "I want"). Mời ai: "Would you like some water?" (Bạn có muốn uống nước không?)

writing.target: Can I see the menu, please?
I'd like|My favourite meal is|At a restaurant, I usually

text_en: Last Saturday, Mai's family went to a new restaurant in town.
The waitress gave them the menu.
For a starter, they had spring rolls with fish sauce.
For the main course, Dad ordered grilled fish and Mum ordered beef noodles.
Mai is a vegetarian, so she had fried rice with tofu and mushrooms.
Her brother wanted something spicy, but the chilli was too hot for him!
For dessert, they all shared a big apple pie.
The food was tasty, and the waitress was friendly.
When Dad asked for the bill, everyone was full and happy.

questions.q: What did they share for dessert?
